item.title: Remediation Center
item.description: One outdated library on one Asset can produce dozens of Findings, and every one of them is closed by the same upgrade. The Remediation Center turns open Findings into the work that fixes them. It groups Findings by the change that resolves them into remediation actions, one per change per location, and gives each action a due date, an owner, and a workflow status.
